short-humorous.voice: Dry, conversational workplace humour. One sharp joke about a recognisable product or organisational absurdity; one useful takeaway. Avoid forced punchlines, slogans, invented quotations and jokes at victims' expense.
short-humorous.opening: Line 1 leads with the strongest supported recognisable name, incident or material scale. Line 2 immediately connects it to the reader's consequence. Humour must preserve the factual meaning.
short-humorous.selection: One batch of three candidates. Shortlist only totals strictly above 18/25. Among those, rank hook first, then total. Other editorial findings are visible advisories. Always deliver all three texts with their exact scores.
